description: Landmark geometry is unreliable for extreme pose, partial faces, occlusion, or artistic orientation.
mitigation: Calibrated abstention; slice evaluation; optional scene fallback only after proof.
trigger: Accepted precision below gate in any critical slice

description: Corpus overrepresents easy selfies and hides device/demographic/lighting failure modes.
mitigation: Dataset cards, slice quotas, double labeling, holdout and external pilot.
trigger: Large metric spread or label disagreement

description: Maker notes or metadata offsets are damaged during transform/write.
mitigation: ExifTool qualification, field-aware policy, before/after diff, safe-copy default.

description: Non-MCU-aligned JPEG transform silently crops or recompresses edges.
mitigation: Explicit policy, dimensions/test vectors, never-silent diagnostics.

description: Crash, lock, antivirus, or power interruption causes source loss during in-place replacement.
mitigation: Same-volume staging, flush, verified backup, journal, atomic replace, fault injection.

description: Cloud placeholders, reparse points, hardlinks, ADS, or network shares violate local-file assumptions.
mitigation: Capability probe, handle identity, safe defaults, explicit unsupported states.

description: GPU/NPU execution provider produces inconsistent output or deployment failures across hardware.
mitigation: CPU deterministic baseline, provider qualification, fallback and provenance.

description: Native/model dependencies increase package size, trigger antivirus, or complicate signing.
mitigation: Early packaging spike, clean-VM testing, signed binaries, SBOM and provenance.
trigger: Install or AV block on supported VM

description: Third-party binary/model license or redistribution terms do not fit distribution.
mitigation: Dependency register and legal review before adoption; adapter allows substitution.

description: Malformed image or metadata exploits native decoder/tool.
mitigation: Patched dependencies, limits, timeouts, fuzzing, least privilege, subprocess isolation where feasible.

description: Logs, thumbnails, or support bundles expose private paths or images.
mitigation: No thumbnails by default, redaction, retention policy, explicit export.

description: SQLite contention or unbounded queues degrade large jobs.
mitigation: Single-writer batches, bounded channels, synthetic 100k/1m tests, checkpoints.
trigger: Memory growth or restart SLA miss

description: Users misinterpret portrait/landscape as aspect ratio rather than upright orientation.
mitigation: Use 'upright orientation' terminology; inspect explanations and previews.

description: A one-command run encourages unsafe in-place expectations.
mitigation: Safe-copy default, explicit in-place acknowledgement, dry-run summaries.

description: HEIC/AVIF availability differs by Windows installation and extensions.
mitigation: Operation-level capability matrix and doctor diagnostics; baseline does not promise unsupported codecs.

description: Intentional sideways/lying-down selfies are 'corrected' against artistic intent.
mitigation: Abstention, sequence context as weak evidence, review queue, never infer aesthetic mirror.
response: Add uncertainty feature/slice and raise threshold.

description: Model or binary update changes behavior without traceability.
mitigation: Digest pinning, signed manifests, compatibility tests, atomic activation/rollback.
response: Quarantine and retain prior active version.

description: Four rotations multiply inference cost and make HDD-heavy collections slow.
mitigation: Bounded thumbnails, batching where proven, metadata fast path, caching, provider acceleration.

description: Documentation and implementation drift, breaking traceability.
mitigation: Machine-readable IDs, CI validator, ADRs, requirement/test gates.
trigger: Orphan or unknown ID in CI

description: Failure reports lack enough provenance to reproduce field issues.
mitigation: Schema-versioned events, environment/model/runtime manifests, redacted support bundles.
trigger: Issue cannot be reproduced from job bundle
